sn35.14:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– pubbeva me bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhi sattasseva sato etadahosi:
sn35.14:1.2: ko nu kho rūpānaṃ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.14:1.7: ko dhammānaṃ assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn35.14:1.9: yaṃ kho rūpe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpānaṃ assādo.
sn35.14:1.10: ye rūpā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ rūpānaṃ ādīnavo.
sn35.14:1.11: yo rūpesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.14:1.16: yaṃ dhamme paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ dhammānaṃ assādo.
sn35.14:1.17: ye dhammā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavo.
sn35.14:1.18: yo dhammesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ dhammānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.14:2.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ channaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato, ādīnavañca ādīnavato, nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ …pe…
sn35.14:2.2: abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn35.14:2.4: akuppā me ceto vimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
